about: The preset and bank wire protocol, version 1, as conversations between a
plugin host and the panel. This is the one copy of the messages:
tests/panel/wire_test.odin replays every scenario against the host, and
tests/ui/preset-wire.test.mjs against the real page, each comparing strings
byte for byte, so a field spelled differently on one side fails there.
It is edited by hand and never regenerated from either side's output: a
copy taken from the code under test cannot disagree with it. A change to
what goes on the wire is a change to this file, read in review.
A scenario's `host` says how the host's instance is set up. An exchange is
one thing the page does (`page_does`: boot, click a button, call a
SynthBank method, `injected`, a request no page can be made to send, or
`idle`, nothing, which is the host's turn),
the strings that puts on the wire (`page_to_host`), the strings the host
answers with, in order (`host_to_page`), and what each side must be
afterwards (`host_effect`, `page_effect`). A string is the bytes sent, so a
quote inside a message is \" here. Key order in the page's messages is
JSON.stringify's own, and is pinned only because the host is fed these
bytes. Any key an effect has that the tests do not read is a failure.
host_does: what the host does by itself first, before it hears the page.
`program_change` is a MIDI Program Change reaching the instance, which
selects the slot and posts nothing; `announce` is the main thread telling
an open editor, as send_selection does, and what it posts is the start of
host_to_page. A host's `selected_slot` is a Program Change that came before
its saved state did.
host_effect: selected (select calls received this exchange), selection and
program (what the instance plays now, null for nothing known), restore,
error, pending (a failed restore kept for a retry), retries, discards,
banks (bank calls: save and origin, origin null when the page sent none),
bank_label, bank_origin, bank_source (built_in, saved or adopted: where
the playing bank comes from), embedded (whether a state saved now carries
the bank), values (the stored sound), patches (slots of the playing bank,
as the host read them out of the page's document).
page_effect: protocol (SynthBridge.version()), selection, status, restore
(restoreState(), exactly), strip (the text of #bank-patch, #bank-name and
#bank-origin), persisted (the labels of the banks a write may ask the
host to save), banner (the restore banner: visible, the ok, failed and
missing lines or null when hidden, their buttons, whether Retry is
disabled), sound ("host" is the sound the scenario's host started with),
index, status_line (#bank-status), result (SynthBank.lastResult()). The
page must also post nothing in answer to the host's strings.
